items.title: What to expect from upcoming summit between Presidents Trump and Xi
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are set to meet in Washington on Sept. 24, with trade, tariffs, Taiwan, the Iran war, and artificial intelligence among the main issues expected to shape their second meeting this year, Reuters reported.

items.title: Russia, Ukraine trade major drone attacks as Moscow oil refinery hit
items.summary: Investing.com -- Russia and Ukraine launched major drone attacks against each other over the weekend, killing civilians on both sides and striking a Moscow oil refinery as attacks on energy infrastructure continued, Reuters reported.

items.title: SanDisk Stock Jumped 11% on S&P 100 News. Here’s What the Street Says.
items.summary: Key TakeawaysIndex Bid: SanDisk stock jumped 11% on Thursday after joining the S&P 100. Street Split: TIKR tracks 25 analysts on SanDisk stock, splitting 16 buys, 4 outperforms, 3 holds, 1 underperform and 1 sell, while the $2,125 mean target sits 19% above Thursday’s $1,792 close.

items.title: Sandisk Joins the S&P 100 on Monday -- the Same Day Nike Leaves It
items.summary: Index funds will need to buy the flash-memory specialist's stock ahead of Monday -- though maybe not much of it.

items.title: Saudi Aramco halts crude oil supply to European customers
items.summary: Investing.com -- Saudi Aramco has informed at least two oil refining customers in Europe that they will receive no crude oil next month following an attack on the kingdom’s main pipeline to the Red Sea, according to a report from Bloomberg News, citing people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Colgate’s Steady Dividend and Premium Push Might Change The Case For Investing In Colgate-Palmolive (CL)
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive’s board recently declared a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.53 per common share, payable on November 13, 2026, to shareholders of record on October 20, 2026, extending a dividend record that has remained uninterrupted since 1895. This reaffirmation of the dividend coincides with Colgate-Palmolive intensifying efforts to revive its North America business through greater support for premium toothpaste innovations and higher advertising investment. items.title: One of These Dividend Kings Pays Out More Than It Earns. Which Dividend Is Safer?
items.summary: Two Dividend Kings with 50-plus years of consecutive raises have reported earnings, and one of them is funding its payout in a way that should raise eyebrows. The question is whether that really makes it the riskier bet.

items.title: Colgate-Palmolive (CL) Lifts Ad Spend As Fair Value Debate Hangs On North America Recovery
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive (CL) is trying to fix a soft North America business after a tough second quarter by ramping support for premium toothpaste, lifting ad spend, and adjusting prices to compete more effectively. Recent trading reflects that mixed backdrop. The share price is US$87.02, with the 30 day share price return down 3.54% and the 90 day share price return down 2.75%.
